info.name: CRM Sales Management API
info.description: Generated from the OpenAPI spec (`npm run docs:postman`). Run **Auth → Log in** first: the access token is stored in `{{accessToken}}` and the refresh token cookie is handled by Postman. Creating a lead/customer/deal/activity stores its id for the follow-up requests.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Registration, login, token refresh, logout, profile

request.description: Public sign-up. The role is always `sales_executive`; admins assign other roles. Disabled when `ALLOW_PUBLIC_REGISTRATION=false`. Sets the `crm_refresh_token` httpOnly cookie.
Returns a short-lived JWT access token in the body and sets a rotating refresh token in the `crm_refresh_token` httpOnly cookie. Accounts lock for 15 minutes after 5 failed attempts.
Uses the `crm_refresh_token` cookie. The refresh token is rotated on every call; re-using an old token revokes the whole session family (theft detection).
Revokes the refresh token from the cookie and clears it. Idempotent.
Revokes every refresh token and invalidates all issued access tokens.
**Roles:** any authenticated user
**Roles:** any authenticated user
Signs out all other sessions and returns a fresh session for the caller.

request.description: **Roles:** admin, sales_manager, sales_executive (record-level scope applies)

Status and assignment have dedicated endpoints. Converted leads are read-only. Priority changes are recorded as `lead_priority_changed`.

**Roles:** admin, sales_manager, sales_executive (record-level scope applies)

Converted leads cannot be deleted. Activities linked to the lead are removed; the audit trail is kept.

**Roles:** admin, sales_manager (managers limited to their team)

Allowed transitions: new → contacted|qualified|unqualified|lost; contacted → qualified|unqualified|lost; qualified → contacted|unqualified|lost; unqualified → contacted|lost; lost → contacted. `converted` is only reachable via /convert. `reason` is required for `lost`.

**Roles:** admin, sales_manager, sales_executive (record-level scope applies)

Assignee must be an active sales executive (managers: within their team). Recorded as `lead_assigned` or `lead_reassigned`.

**Roles:** admin, sales_manager (managers limited to their team)

item.name: Convert lead to customer (+ optional deal)

request.description:
Only `qualified`, assigned leads can be converted, exactly once. Runs in a MongoDB transaction: lead status, customer, deal, back-references and timeline entries are committed atomically. Customer fields default to the lead's data.

**Roles:** admin, sales_manager, sales_executive (record-level scope applies)

**Roles:** admin, sales_manager (managers limited to their team); won deals: admin only

- Open stages can move freely between each other; probability defaults to the configured stage probability.
- `won`: value must be > 0, linked customer must exist, owner must be active; probability = 100. Optional `finalValue`.
- `lost`: `lostReason` required; probability = 0.
- Closed → open: only admin/manager with `reopenReason`. Won ↔ Lost directly is not allowed.
